steps.text:
Subject: Scheduled Network Maintenance – {{p:site}} Data Center (Saturday 22:00‑02:00)

Hi Team,

Please be advised that we have a planned network maintenance window for the {{p:site}} data center this Saturday:

- **Date:** Saturday, [Insert Date]  
- **Time:** 22:00 – 02:00 (local {{p:site}} time)  
- **Scope:** Core switches, firewall updates, and related routing equipment.

**Impact:**  
During this 4‑hour window, you may experience brief connectivity interruptions or increased latency on services hosted in the {{p:site}} facility. All critical systems will remain monitored, and we will aim to complete the work within the scheduled timeframe.

**What you need to do:**  
- Review any scheduled jobs or deployments that might be affected and adjust timing if possible.  
- Notify any external partners or customers who rely on {{p:site}}‑based services.  
- Report any post‑maintenance issues to the Network Operations team promptly.

We appreciate your cooperation and understanding as we perform these essential upgrades to improve reliability and performance.

If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out to the Network Operations team.

Thanks,  
[Your Name]  
Network Operations Lead  
Probler Data Center Services
